basic_details.job_title: VMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for Trade Apprentice Posts
basic_details.application_mode: Online, via two-step registration (Apprenticeship India portal + VMC website)

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Std. 10 (SSC) pass; age limit 18 to 28 years

qualification.details: Candidates must hold the qualification specified for their chosen trade in the table above. The Office Assistant trade (S. No. 18) is open to female candidates only, with an age limit of 18 to 28 years. Age limit for the remaining 17 trades is not specified in this notification. Candidates are engaged as trainee apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961; local (Vadodara) candidates are given priority in engagement.

salary_details.details: Apprentices engaged under the Apprentices Act, 1961, will receive a stipend as per the rules prescribed under that Act. Specific stipend amounts for each trade are not stated in this notification.

how_to_apply: Applying involves two separate steps, both of which must be completed for the application to be accepted.
Register as an apprentice on the national Apprenticeship India portal: apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
After registering your apprenticeship trade preference on that portal, complete your eKYC update on the same portal.
After registering the trade preference and updating eKYC on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, submit the online application through the VMC website: vmc.gov.in/Recruitment/Recruitment.aspx.
Ensure the mobile number and e-mail address entered in the application form are correct and currently in your own use, as these will be used for all further document-verification communication.
Candidates who complete only one of the two steps - portal registration or the VMC website application - will not have a valid application; both are mandatory.
important_instructions: Candidates engaged under the Apprentices Act, 1961, are covered by its stipend and other applicable rules. Local (Vadodara) resident candidates will be given priority in the selection/engagement process. If a candidate applies for a trade for which they are not eligible, and this is discovered after selection, their apprenticeship will be cancelled. For document verification, the mobile number and e-mail address submitted in the application form must be accurate; if the online application was submitted using someone else's mobile number or e-mail address, the candidate bears responsibility for this. VMC is not responsible if a candidate becomes unreachable later due to a change in mobile number or e-mail address. All applications and certificates will be scrutinised; if a candidate's local-residency proof is found to be false or incorrect, if required certificates are found incorrect, or if fraudulent/false certificates are submitted with the application, that candidature will be cancelled at any stage of the process.

faq.question: Q1. What is VMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification by Vadodara Municipal Corporation for engaging Trainee Apprentices across 18 trades for the year 2026-27, under the Apprentices Act, 1961, and the Chief Minister Apprentice Yojana.

faq.question: Q2. How many trades are covered under VMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 18 trades, including Electrician, Fitter, Wireman, COPA, Mechanic Diesel, Office Operations Executive, and Office Assistant (female-only), among others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for VMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 25 August 2026, 11:59 PM. Applications opened on 13 August 2026 at 12:00 noon.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for VMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It varies by trade - mostly an ITI trade-pass qualification, except Office Operations Executive (BA/B.Com/BBA) and Office Assistant (Std. 10 pass, female candidates only).

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for VMC apprentices?
faq.answer: As per the rules prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961; exact amounts are not specified in this notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for VMC Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By first registering on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and completing eKYC, and then submitting the application on vmc.gov.in/Recruitment/Recruitment.aspx. Both steps are mandatory.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Office Assistant post open to male candidates?
faq.answer: No, the Office Assistant trade is specified as open to female candidates only.

faq.question: Q8. Are local Vadodara candidates given preference?
faq.answer: Yes, the notification states that local resident candidates will be given priority.
